reported.title: Log period is 2000 ms, not 500 ms
reported.description: loop() calls emitLog() once per iteration and then blocks in delay(2000) at line 75, so serial lines are emitted every ~2000 ms instead of the required 500 ms. The measured evidence confirms this: '5 of 5 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 2001 ms' with gaps of 2000 ms between lines. The LOG_MS constant at line 8 is never used to schedule logging. Expected /^flow: / every 500 ± 100 ms; 5 of 5 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 2001 ms.

reported.title: Printed flow is raw ADC counts, not converted L/h
reported.description: readFlowLph() at lines 16-19 returns the raw analogRead() count directly, with no 5.000 V/1023 span conversion to millivolts and no division by 2 mV/Lph. The measured evidence shows 'printed 202 Lph at 8.02 s while the injected input was 489.7 to 510.9 Lph: off by 287.7 Lph', consistent with raw counts being printed as if they were L/h. Firmware printed 202 Lph at 8.02 s while the injected input was 489.7 to 510.9 Lph: off by 287.7 Lph (tolerance ±10). 5 of 5 values were wrong.

reported.title: Alarm threshold compares raw counts to 100 L/h
reported.description: flowLooksLow() at lines 27-30 compares the raw ADC count (0-1023) against LOW_FLOW_LPH=100.0f, so the alarm actually trips at raw 100 (~488 mV / ~244 L/h) rather than the specified 100 L/h (200 mV / raw ~41). The measured evidence shows 'D8 was not LOW for 2451 ms while required' on the nominal ramp and 'D8 was not HIGH for 970 ms while required' on the glitch spike, confirming the threshold is misplaced and unfiltered. D8 was in the wrong state for 3410 ms across 2 interval(s), first at 1.55 s: D8 was not LOW for 2451 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: Firmware silent for 2000 ms due to blocking delay
reported.description: The unconditional delay(2000) at line 75 blocks the loop for 2 seconds, and since D8 is static in most scenarios there is no serial or pin activity during that window. The measured evidence shows 'Firmware went silent for 2000 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 900 ms); 5 such gap(s)', exceeding the 900 ms limit. Firmware went silent for 2000 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 900 ms); 5 such gap(s).

judge_input.spec:
- Flow transducer on A0 scaled at 2 mV/Lph; low-flow alarm lamp on D8.
- Convert ADC with a 5.000 V / 1023 span, then divide millivolts by 2 to obtain L/h.
- Print `flow: <value>` every 500 ms with one decimal place.
- Printed flow must match the injected value within ±10 L/h.
- Drive D8 HIGH when flow is below 100 L/h; otherwise LOW.
- Firmware must never go silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 900 ms.
